newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain mulls restricting 1997 spending further.
newsitem.headline: Spain mulls restricting 1997 spending further.

text.p: Spain is studying the possibility of containing spending growth in the 1997 budget by even more than previously planned, said Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato.

"Spending growth will be less than the forecast for inflation, that is, less than 2.6 percent, and will be around 2.4 percent. We are studying the possibility of reducing it more," Rato said after the regular cabinet meeting. Rato said the basis for comparison was the initial 1996 budget.
Earlier this week, budget office director Jose Barea said spending would grow by around two percent in 1997 compared with the final budget for this year.
